arms.full69_k{1,2,4,8,16,32,64}: 11b symtab: readout_subspace over the 69 tokens of das/out/bases.pt (28 test + 41 other countries); reproduction check, expected = 11b symtab arm
arms.a69_k{8,16,32,64}: Q1(a): readout_subspace over 69 single-token country names with NO test country: the 41 non-test tokens of the 11b vocabulary (38 training countries + 3 others) + 28 extras drawn with random.Random(20261114).sample from the name-sorted single-token sovereign-country candidates (vocab.json a69; all single-token, no multi-piece fallback needed)
arms.aall_k{8,16,32,64}: Q1(a'): the same without subsampling: 41 + all 50 single-token extras (91 tokens, no test country)

arms.saeA_k{1,2,4,8,16,32}: Q2 rule A (test-free): top-k of the 58 census country features (exp1/census.json) ranked by the norm of the cell image W_V^g(gamma d_f) of the decoder direction (weights only; rho divides out), ties by feature id; subspace = span of the k images (the image span is rho-independent: asserted per pair)
arms.saeB_k{...}: Q2 rule B (TEST-INFORMED: the census items include the 64 base items): the census's own evidence order: share on its country k/n desc, off-country count asc, feature id asc
arms.saeC_k{...}: Q2 rule C (TEST-INFORMED, per pair): exp7's per-pair feature set (census features active at L19 at the carrier row of recipient or donor) ranked by rule A, truncated to k (equals exp7's sae arm once k >= its rank)
arms.sae: exp7's per-pair SAE pushforward subspace (reproduction: expected 4/64)

decision_rule_Q1: at k=32, margin 1: a69 >= 28/64 (>= 0.8 of 35) = vocabulary size explains the lead; a69 <= 20/64 = test identity explains it (38 -> 69 tokens without the test countries does not help); 21..27 = mixed. Same reading at margin 4 and at k=16.

predictions.V1: a69 at k=32 >= 24/64 (size is the main factor)
predictions.V2: lto at k=32 >= 30/64 (dropping only the pair's own two countries barely hurts)
predictions.V2_falsifier: lto at k=32 <= 25/64 (the pair's own countries' tokens carry the lead)
predictions.V3: aall at k=32 >= a69 at k=32 - 3 (more tokens do not hurt)
